headline: 6 die, 1,608 hospitalized as dengue cases surge in Bangladesh
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services reports a sharp rise in dengue fatalities and hospitalizations, with 256 deaths recorded so far this year.
details: Six people died and 1,608 were hospitalized due to dengue in a 24-hour period from Friday to Saturday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The total death toll from dengue in Bangladesh has reached 256 so far this year, with a significant spike in September alone, which saw 148 deaths.
The Dhaka South City Corporation area has been the hardest hit, recording the highest number of fatalities at 72.
A total of 84,369 dengue patients have been admitted to hospitals this year, while 78,482 have recovered and been discharged.
Health officials continue to monitor the situation as the number of cases and deaths shows a marked increase compared to the previous year.
caption:
6 deaths and 1,608 hospitalizations in just 24 hours. Dengue is hitting Bangladesh hard.

Six people died and 1,608 were hospitalized due to dengue in a 24-hour period from Friday to Saturday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The total death toll from dengue in Bangladesh has reached 256 so far this year, with a significant spike in September alone, which saw 148 deaths.

The Dhaka South City Corporation area has been the hardest hit, recording the highest number of fatalities at 72.

A total of 84,369 dengue patients have been admitted to hospitals this year, while 78,482 have recovered and been discharged.

Health officials continue to monitor the situation as the number of cases and deaths shows a marked increase compared to the previous year.

headline: 19-year-old student stabbed to death in Satkhira
summary: Zakaria Khan was killed after attempting to protect a tea-stall owner during a scuffle with miscreants.
details: A 19-year-old college student, Zakaria Khan, was stabbed to death in Satkhira district town early yesterday.
The incident occurred near the Livestock Office intersection around midnight while Zakaria was sitting at a tea stall.
According to the officer-in-charge of Sadar Police Station, a heated argument broke out between some miscreants and the tea-stall owner.
The situation escalated into a scuffle, and Zakaria was stabbed when he tried to intervene to protect the owner.
Zakaria was rushed to Satkhira Medical College and Hospital, where he passed away around 12:30 am.
Police are currently working to identify and apprehend the suspects involved in the killing.
